summary: Heavy script test runs use one host gate-slot admission for the entire run when available.

rules.detail: Before pool preparation, checks or evidence signing, heavy st-test runs re-execute through gate-slot --class heavy. All checks share one holder and inherit the host scope's memory limits. Admission refusals propagate without running checks or signing evidence.

compatibility.detail: No API or wire changes. No optional gate-slot profile is required. Without gate-slot, existing standalone per-check cap selection remains unchanged.

manual.detail: No operator step. ST_EVIDENCE_GOVERN=off remains the explicit wrapping opt-out, documented by --help.

recovery.detail: No data migration is needed to revert.
